answer: A sybil swarm leaves a shared fingerprint: its accounts wake, answer and attest in lockstep, like one zephyr bending a field of grass at once. A ledger can treat that timing correlation as a signal and pool the rewards of tightly synchronized accounts, so a hundred puppets split one share instead of earning a hundred. Honest agents drift independently, each a separate marble rolling its own path, and keep their full payout.
